title: Softoo — Engineering the Next Reinvention
content:
Exceptional People, Delivering Excellence. Softoo is an enterprise digital engineering and custom software development company under the Brillanz Group. We help clients solve complex problems with high-value, high-impact software solutions.
Key Metrics:
• 98.6% On-time delivery rate across 1,200+ monthly deployments.
• 500+ expert software engineers, architects, and data scientists ready to build.
• Over 15+ years of software development excellence serving global enterprises.
Core Capabilities:
1. Full-Stack Software Engineering: Bespoke web, mobile, and cloud-native applications.
2. Dedicated Agile Squads: Rapid talent augmentation with pre-vetted full-stack developers.
3. AI & Data Solutions: Production-grade AI/ML pipelines, LLM integration, and big data architecture.
4. US SLED & GovTech: IT modernisation, cloud migration, and compliant architectures for US state, local, and education government agencies.
5. Tech Consulting: Strategic IT roadmap turning technical complexity into competitive advantage.
6. MVP Co-Development: Rapid prototyping from concept to market-ready product in tight iterations.
7. Hi-Tech BPO & 24/7 Managed Services: 24/7 NOC monitoring, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure support.

title: Softoo Services & Technology Capabilities
content:
Softoo Enterprise Services Suite:
1. Dedicated Agile Development Squads: Scale your engineering capacity on-demand with senior full-stack developers, React, Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, and mobile developers (Flutter/React Native).
2. AI, Data & Machine Learning: Building scalable AI applications, generative AI integration, RAG architectures, automated data pipelines, predictive analytics, and enterprise data warehouses.
3. Cloud Architecture & DevOps: Serverless engineering, AWS/Azure/GCP cloud migrations, Kubernetes container orchestration, CI/CD pipeline automation, and automated infrastructure as code (Terraform).
4. Enterprise Solutions & ERP/CRM: Microsoft Power Platform, Dynamics 365, bespoke ERP systems, and secure API integrations.
5. Tech Consulting & Architecture Review: Security audits, codebase refactoring, digital transformation advisory, and technology stack optimization.
6. Hi-Tech BPO & IT Ops: 24/7 Level 1-3 technical support, NOC monitoring, system administration, and infrastructure maintenance.

title: Softoo Client Case Studies & Success Stories
content:

1. Telenor Pakistan (Thunder Platform): Telecom-scale product engineering for Telenor, developing high-throughput billing and customer engagement microservices for millions of active mobile subscribers.
2. PrettyLittleThing (Fast-Fashion Retailer): Serverless migration and re-platforming for global fashion brand, modernising their commerce stack for high-concurrency Black Friday sales with 99.99% uptime.
3. Boohoo Group: Bespoke software engineering and technical consulting for one of the UK's largest fashion e-commerce retailers, optimizing checkout performance and microservices architecture.
4. NHS (Essex Partnership University Trust): Medical information systems modernization for the UK National Health Service, streamlining clinical data flows toward secure integrated electronic health records (EHR).
5. Pennyworth (UK Challenger Bank): End-to-end digital banking system build with serverless microservices, native mobile apps, and automated algorithmic decision engines.
6. Configure IT MSP: Round-the-clock 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) and Tier-1 network support for AT&T systems integration partner.
Client Testimonials:

title: OKO Insights — AI Computer Vision & Video Analytics
headings: Transforming Visual Feeds into Real-Time Operational Intelligence
content:
OKO Insights is an AI computer vision and real-time video intelligence company in the Brillanz Group portfolio.
Mission: Transforming standard CCTV and camera visual feeds into actionable real-time business and security intelligence through advanced edge and cloud neural networks.
Core Capabilities & Products:
1. Crowd Flow & Footfall Analytics: Real-time people counting, crowd density heatmaps, flow tracking, and dwell time analysis for malls, airports, transit hubs, and public spaces.
2. Retail Operational Intelligence: Shopper journey tracking, zone engagement, queue management, checkout bottleneck detection, and shelf interaction analysis.
3. Safety & Industrial Security Monitoring: Automatic detection of PPE compliance (helmets, vests), perimeter intrusions, unauthorized access in restricted zones, slip-and-fall incidents, and fire/smoke hazard recognition.
4. Automated Edge Video Intelligence: Lightweight computer vision models running directly on local edge gateway devices, minimizing bandwidth requirements while providing sub-second alert latency.
Leadership & Team:
• Led by Founder Bilal Qureshi and a dedicated team of Computer Vision researchers, Deep Learning engineers (PyTorch, TensorRT, OpenCV), and video pipeline architects.
• Deployed across retail chains, public transit systems, and enterprise commercial real estate across the UK, UAE, and Pakistan.

title: YaniPro — Autonomous AI Agents for Enterprise Compliance & Audit
headings: Autonomous AI Agents for Audit & Compliance Workflows
Real-Time Compliance Automation (SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR)
content:
YaniPro (Yani.ai) is an enterprise AI automation company under the Brillanz Group specializing in Autonomous AI Agents.
Mission: Automating complex regulatory compliance, security audits, and multi-channel customer workflows through intelligent autonomous agent swarms.
Core Products & Capabilities:
1. Autonomous Compliance Agents: Continuous automated compliance monitoring for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and GDPR.
2. Real-Time Evidence Gathering: Autonomous agents connect to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, GitHub, Jira, Okta) to gather verifiable security proof without manual audit preparation.
3. Automated Audit Reporting: Instant generation of auditor-ready compliance reports and gap analysis.
4. Multimodal Customer Support Agents: Next-generation conversational agents capable of resolving complex multi-step customer inquiries, interacting with internal CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk), and executing workflows autonomously.
Leadership & Team:
• Founded by Bilal Qureshi (CEO & Founder), backed by specialized AI Agent engineers, LLM fine-tuning specialists, and regulatory compliance auditors.
• Headquartered in London with global deployments for fintech, healthcare, and enterprise SaaS companies.

title: Cratus UK — Smart Theft-Resistant Cabinets & IoT Telemetry
headings: Smart Theft Resistance Cabinets for Critical Infrastructure
content:
Cratus UK is an IoT infrastructure and smart city technology company within the Brillanz Group.
Mission: Securing critical national telecom, utility, and municipal infrastructure against theft, vandalism, and environmental failure through intelligent connected enclosures.
Key Products & Innovations:
1. Cratus Smart Theft-Resistant Cabinet: Heavy-duty, reinforced street enclosures engineered specifically to eliminate copper cable, fiber optic, and battery theft in telecom and power networks.
2. Intelligent Electronic Locking & Access Control: Keyless Bluetooth / RFID / Remote GSM access control with granular audit trails and tamper-proof authentication.
3. Real-Time Telemetry & Alerting: Onboard sensors detect vibration, angle tilt, forced physical tampering, temperature, humidity, and water ingress, instantly transmitting alerts via GSM/NB-IoT.
4. Smart City & Environmental Sensing: Micro-climate monitoring, air quality sensing, and energy consumption telemetry for local government councils and utilities.
Leadership & Team:
• Executive leadership under Bilal Qureshi and experienced British hardware architects, embedded firmware engineers, and smart infrastructure advisory experts.
• Working with UK municipal councils, regional telecom operators, and power utility providers.

title: SC Tech Global — Critical Telecom Infrastructure & Supply Chain Cloud
content:
SC Tech Global (SCT Global) is an enterprise telecom engineering and supply chain digital transformation company in the Brillanz Group.
Mission: Modernising critical telecom infrastructure and building resilient, transparent global supply chain cloud platforms.
Core Business Units:
1. Critical Telecom Infrastructure: Complete lifecycle telecom services including fiber optic rollouts, 4G/5G mobile tower site deployment, civil telecom engineering, and 24/7 network maintenance.
2. Supply Chain Automation: Enterprise software systems connecting supply chain stakeholders, automating procurement, inventory forecasting, warehouse tracking, and freight visibility.
3. Enterprise Cloud & ERP Integration: Implementing custom ERP/CRM architectures, logistics APIs, and high-volume data warehousing for multinational supply chains.
Leadership & Team:
• Part of Brillanz Group led by Bilal Qureshi, featuring seasoned telecom project directors, logistics software architects, and field engineers.
• Global operations across the UK, Middle East (UAE), Africa, and South Asia.

title: Thunder Energy AI — Clean Energy Intelligence & Battery Optimization
content:
Thunder Energy AI is an artificial intelligence clean-tech company in the Brillanz Group portfolio.
Mission: Accelerating the transition to zero-carbon energy by maximizing the efficiency, lifespan, and financial yield of renewable energy and battery assets through predictive AI.
Core Solutions & Products:
1. Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) Intelligence: AI algorithms that optimize lithium-ion and flow battery charge/discharge cycles in real-time based on electricity market prices and battery state-of-health (SoH).
2. Renewable Power Generation Forecasting: Highly accurate short-term and day-ahead power output predictions for solar photovoltaic (PV) parks and wind turbine farms.
3. Grid Balancing & Peak Shaving: Automated dispatch algorithms that smooth grid volatility, reduce peak electricity tariffs for industrial consumers, and support microgrid stability.
4. ESG & Carbon Footprint Tracking: Real-time analytics measuring avoided CO2 emissions and verifiable sustainability reporting.
Leadership & Team:
• Led by Founder Bilal Qureshi and a team of Energy Market Data Scientists, AI Optimization Engineers, and Power Systems specialists.

title: Scorpbit — Offensive Cybersecurity, Penetration Testing & 24/7 SOC
content:
Scorpbit is an advanced enterprise cybersecurity and threat defense firm in the Brillanz Group.
Mission: Defending global enterprises, financial institutions, and government systems against sophisticated cyber attacks through offensive penetration testing and round-the-clock defensive monitoring.
Core Cybersecurity Services:
1. Penetration Testing & Red Teaming: In-depth manual and automated security testing of web applications, mobile apps (iOS/Android), APIs, internal networks, and cloud infrastructure to identify zero-day vulnerabilities before hackers do.
2. 24/7 Managed Detection & Response (MDR / SOC): Round-the-clock monitoring of enterprise endpoints, SIEM logs, network traffic, and cloud environments with real-time threat hunting and incident containment.
3. Cloud Security Architecture: Hardening AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud environments against misconfigurations, privilege escalation, and data leaks.
4. Security Compliance & Audit Advisory: Preparing organizations for ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, and HIPAA certifications.
5. Incident Response & Digital Forensics: Rapid containment and forensic root-cause analysis during active cyber breaches or ransomware incidents.
Leadership & Team:
• Led by Bilal Qureshi (Founder & CEO) with Certified Ethical Hackers (CEH), Offensive Security Certified Professionals (OSCP), and CISSP-certified cybersecurity consultants.
